title: Whole Alternating Branch and Bilobed Fan Leaf Sapling
description: One complete newly authored stylised ginkgo-like young tree: a slender gently zigzag tapering trunk carries alternating whole upward-curving woody branches at several heights. Fine separate petioles join broad continuous fan-shaped leaf blades with genuine shallow central distal notches and slight lamina curvature. This is neither an orchard tree with recoloured crown blobs nor an unbranched terminal palm with fewer fan fingers. All whole trunk, branch and fan outlines are newly authored, without importing old geometry. One static plant model, zero scenes. Artistic external form only, not exact species, age, leaf venation science, medicinal status, growth, wind, cultivation or ecological suitability; roots below the display datum, rig and animation not made.
